title: Foul Potion
description:
Deal [blue]12[/blue] damage to ALL players and enemies.
Can be thrown at the [gold]Merchant[/gold] for [blue]100[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] instead.
notes: This potion has dual functionality: in combat, it damages all enemies and players; outside combat at a Merchant (shop or Fake Merchant event), it can be thrown at the merchant button to gain gold instead.
